searchDocs.title: Method 1 - Package Manager (Wally)​
searchDocs.content: Using Wally, just add igneous = "notkaif/igneous@3.0.1" to your wally.toml Then run   wally install   in the command line!  Need the exported Luau types?Using wally-package-types run  wally-package-types --sourcemap sourcemap.json Packages/

searchDocs.title: Method 2 - Manual​
searchDocs.content: Visit the latest releaseUnder Assets, find the .rbxm file and import it into Studio` Note: This does not automatically update

searchDocs.title: Templates
searchDocs.content: Templates This page contains the templates you need for Igneous viewmodels, data modules and modpacks.

searchDocs.title: RegisterModpack​
searchDocs.content: </> ModpackManager:RegisterModpack(modpack: ModuleScript ) → () Requires and registers a modpack, making its hooks eligible for dispatch.

searchDocs.title: TriggerHook​
searchDocs.content: </> ModpackManager:TriggerHook( hook: Hooks, ...: any-- Arguments passed to each modpack's hook handler ) → () Calls the given hook on every registered modpack that implements it. Return values are discarded — use this for fire-and-forget lifecycle notifications.

searchDocs.title: CheckGate​
searchDocs.content: </> ModpackManager:CheckGate( hook: GateHooks, ...: any-- Arguments passed to each modpack's hook handler ) → boolean-- False if any modpack vetoed the action Calls the given gate hook on every registered modpack that implements it, stopping at the first modpack that returns false. Modpacks that return nothing (or true) do not block the action.

searchDocs.title: SumHook​
searchDocs.content: </> ModpackManager:SumHook( hook: SumHooks, ...: any-- Arguments passed to each modpack's hook handler ) → vector-- The sum of every modpack's contribution Calls the given hook on every registered modpack that implements it and sums their returned vectors. Modpacks that return nothing contribute zero.

searchDocs.title: Firemode​
searchDocs.content: </> type Firemode = "Semi" | "Auto" | "Burst" Represents the three hardcoded weapon firemodes

searchDocs.title: LockAxes​
searchDocs.content: </> type LockAxes = { X: boolean, Y: boolean, Z: boolean } Which axes of the viewmodel's rotation should stay frozen relative to the camera.

searchDocs.title: RecoilData​
searchDocs.content: </> type RecoilData = { Vertical: number, Horizontal: number } The magnitude of vertical and horizontal recoil applied per shot.

searchDocs.title: RuntimeState​
searchDocs.content: </> type RuntimeState = { Lock: LockAxes?, Offset: vector?, IsAiming: boolean, Accuracy: number, MaxSpread: number, Range: number, Cooldown: number, Recoil: RecoilData } Mutable per-weapon state that modpacks can read and change at runtime via SetLock, SetOffset, SetAiming, and UpdateData, seeded from the weapon's Data on creation.

searchDocs.title: StagedReloadStage​
searchDocs.content: </> type StagedReloadStage = { Name: string, Duration: number, Cancellable: boolean, AmmoTransfer: number?, CanFireAfter: boolean } A single stage in a Staged reload. AmmoTransfer moves that many rounds from Reserve to Amount when the stage completes; omit it for stages with no ammo movement (e.g. racking a bolt). CanFireAfter controls whether the weapon may fire once this stage completes, or must wait for a later stage.

searchDocs.title: SimpleReloadData​
searchDocs.content: </> type SimpleReloadData = { Type: "Simple", Duration: number, Cancellable: boolean } A single wait-then-fill reload with no intermediate stages.

searchDocs.title: StagedReloadData​
searchDocs.content: </> type StagedReloadData = { Type: "Staged", Stages: {StagedReloadStage} } A reload made up of ordered stages, each independently cancellable and able to gate firing and ammo transfer.

searchDocs.title: ProgressiveReloadData​
searchDocs.content: </> type ProgressiveReloadData = { Type: "Progressive", Duration: number, AmountPerCycle: number, Cancellable: boolean } A reload that repeats a single cycle, adding AmountPerCycle rounds each time, until full or out of reserve. Used for pellet-fed or single-load weapons.

searchDocs.title: ReloadData​
searchDocs.content: </> type ReloadData = SimpleReloadData | StagedReloadData | ProgressiveReloadData A weapon's reload configuration, set via Data.Reload.

searchDocs.title: AmmoData​
searchDocs.content: </> type AmmoData = { Amount: number, Max: number, Reserve: number } A weapon's current ammo state.

searchDocs.title: Hooks​
searchDocs.content: </> type Hooks = "OnEquip" | "OnUnequip" | "OnFireStart" | "OnFireEnd" | "OnFire" | "OnProjectileFire" | "OnAmmoChange" | "OnAimStart" | "OnAimEnd" | "OnCameraUpdate" Notify hooks: dispatched to every modpack that implements them, return values discarded.

searchDocs.title: GateHooks​
searchDocs.content: </> type GateHooks = "OnBeforeFire" | "OnBeforeAim" | "OnBeforeReload" Veto hooks: any modpack returning false blocks the action.

searchDocs.title: SumHooks​
searchDocs.content: </> type SumHooks = "OnCameraUpdate" Accumulate hooks: every modpack's returned vector is summed.

searchDocs.title: new​
searchDocs.content: </> Igneous.new( name: string, viewmodel: Model ,-- Refer to the templates page to see an example viewmodel data: ModuleScript -- The weapon's Data module, see the templates page for its schema ) → IgneousWeapon Creates a new weapon

searchDocs.title: Data Module Structure
searchDocs.content: Data Module Structure A data module must be passed into Igneous.new() to give Igneous data about the weapon. Here's how the data module must be structured: return function() return { -- REQUIRED CanFire = true, Accuracy = 0.8, Range = 300, MaxSpread = 3, Ammo = 20, MaxAmmo = 20, Reserve = 100, Firemode = "Semi", -- "Semi" | "Auto" | "Burst" Cooldown = 0.1, Projectiles = 1, -- Pick ONE of the three Reload examples below and delete the other two -- Simple example — waits Duration, then fills to Max in one transfer Reload = { Type = "Simple", Duration = 1.5, Cancellable = true, }, -- Staged example (for multi-stage reloads such as mag out, mag in, bolt pull) Reload = { Type = "Staged", Stages = { { Name = "MagOut", Duration = 0.4, Cancellable = true, CanFireAfter = false }, { Name = "MagIn", Duration = 0.6, Cancellable = true, AmmoTransfer = 30, CanFireAfter = false }, { Name = "BoltPull", Duration = 0.3, Cancellable = false, CanFireAfter = true }, }, }, -- Progressive example (for shotguns, or other single-load weapons) Reload = { Type = "Progressive", Duration = 0.5, AmountPerCycle = 1, Cancellable = true, }, AimSpeed = 0.7, CanReloadWhileAiming = false, CanAim = true, -- OPTIONAL, hardcoded support Lock = { X = true, Y = false, Z = false }, Offset = vector.create(0, 0, 0), -- OPTIONAL EXAMPLES, not hardcoded DisplayName = "Name", Damage = { Torso = 50, Head = 80, Limbs = 20, Armor = 30 }, Recoil = { Vertical = 2.1, Horizontal = 0.6, }, } end

searchDocs.title: What is Igneous?​
searchDocs.content: Igneous is a lightweight, modular FPS framework for Roblox providing core weapon mechanics with a hook-based modpack system. You can create FPS games super easily, by dropping in premade modpacks.  Here are some quick links to get started with Igneous:  APIInstallation guideTemplates

searchDocs.title: Viewmodel Structure
searchDocs.content: Viewmodel Structure An Igneous Viewmodel must contain 2 items to function properly: A Primary Part The viewmodel must be a Model instanceThe primary part is where the viewmodel will bind to the camera An Animator Igneous animates your viewmodels using Motus

searchDocs.title: Name​
searchDocs.content: </> IgneousWeapon.Name: string The name of the weapon

searchDocs.title: Viewmodel​
searchDocs.content: </> IgneousWeapon.Viewmodel: Model  The cloned viewmodel instance for this weapon

searchDocs.title: Animator​
searchDocs.content: </> IgneousWeapon.Animator: MotusAnimator The Motus animator for controlling weapon animations. See the specific documentation for usage.

searchDocs.title: Equip​
searchDocs.content: </> IgneousWeapon:Equip() → () Equips the weapon, making it visible and triggering the OnEquip hook for all registered modpacks. The viewmodel is parented to Workspace and becomes active.

searchDocs.title: Unequip​
searchDocs.content: </> IgneousWeapon:Unequip() → () Unequips the weapon, hiding it and triggering the OnUnequip hook for all registered modpacks. The viewmodel is parented back to ReplicatedStorage and becomes inactive.

searchDocs.title: Reload​
searchDocs.content: </> IgneousWeapon:Reload() → () Begins (or resumes) the weapon's reload sequence. No-ops if already reloading, unequipped, full on ammo, out of reserve, aiming while CanReloadWhileAiming is false, or blocked by a modpack's OnBeforeReload. If a previous Staged reload was cancelled mid-stage, resumes from that stage.

searchDocs.title: CancelReload​
searchDocs.content: </> IgneousWeapon:CancelReload() → () Interrupts an in-progress reload, if the current stage allows it. For a Staged reload, the stage index is preserved, so calling Reload again resumes (restarts) from the interrupted stage rather than starting over from the beginning.

searchDocs.title: SetRuntime​
searchDocs.content: </> IgneousWeapon:SetRuntime( changes: {[string]: any}-- Partial fields to overwrite ) → () Overwrites weapon stats. Accuracy, MaxSpread, Range, Cooldown, Recoil, Offset, and Lock are runtime-mutable and are written to _Runtime

searchDocs.title: GetRuntime​
searchDocs.content: </> IgneousWeapon:GetRuntime() → RuntimeState Returns a shallow copy of the weapon's current runtime state (Lock, Offset, IsAiming, Accuracy, MaxSpread, Range, Cooldown, Recoil). A copy, not the live table, so mutating the result can't bypass SetRuntime/SetAiming and their side effects.

searchDocs.title: SetAiming​
searchDocs.content: </> IgneousWeapon:SetAiming(isAiming: boolean) → () Toggles the weapon's aiming state and triggers OnAimStart/OnAimEnd for registered modpacks. Does not itself change any camera behavior — modpacks read Weapon._Runtime.IsAiming to react.

searchDocs.title: SetFiring​
searchDocs.content: </> IgneousWeapon:SetFiring( shouldFire: boolean-- Whether the weapon should start or stop firing ) → () Controls the weapon's firing state. When set to true, begins firing based on the weapon's firemode (Semi, Burst, or Auto). When set to false, stops firing (Auto only — Semi/Burst always complete their sequence). Triggers OnFireStart and OnFireEnd hooks accordingly. Only works when the weapon is equipped, not blocked by a reload, and has ammunition.

searchDocs.title: Modpack Structure
searchDocs.content: Modpack Structure Igneous uses modpacks to extend the functionality of your weapons. Some examples may be a modpack that damages humanoids when a weapon is shot, or something purely visual like muzzle flashes, bullet holes, etc. You can also store store assets inside of your modpack, for example instances, extra modules, etc. Note: Although Igneous modpacks are supposed to be extremely portable, we do not recommend putting your server scripts inside your Modpack. Put your server scripts in ServerScriptService. A template modpack can be found here, or you can see one here: -- References to "Motus" can be removed if you don't animate the viewmodel -- Or if you don't need the autocomplete, where you can also remove the other types (Not recommended) local Motus = require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Motus) type Weapon = { Name: string, Viewmodel: Model, Animator: Motus.MotusAnimator, } type StagedReloadStage = { Name: string, Duration: number, Cancellable: boolean, AmmoTransfer: number?, CanFireAfter: boolean, } local Modpack = {} function Modpack.OnEquip(weapon: Weapon) print(weapon.Name, "has been equipped") end function Modpack.OnUnequip(weapon: Weapon) print(weapon.Name, "has been unequipped") end function Modpack.OnFireStart(weapon: Weapon) print(weapon.Name, "has started firing") end function Modpack.OnFireEnd(weapon: Weapon) print(weapon.Name, "has stopped firing") end function Modpack.OnFire(weapon: Weapon) print(weapon.Name, "has fired") end function Modpack.OnProjectileFire( weapon: Weapon, origin: { position: Vector3, direction: Vector3 }, result: RaycastResult? ) print(weapon.Name, "has cast a projectile from", origin.position) if result then print("..." .. "and has hit the part", result.Instance.Name, "at", result.Position) end end function Modpack.OnAmmoChange(weapon: Weapon, previous: number, current: number, reason: "reload" | "fired" | "set") print(weapon.Name, "has changed from", previous, "bullets to", current, "because a", reason, "happened") end function Modpack.OnAimStart(weapon: Weapon) print(weapon.Name, "has started aiming") end function Modpack.OnAimEnd(weapon: Weapon) print(weapon.Name, "has stopped aiming") end function Modpack.OnCameraUpdate(weapon: Weapon, dt: number): vector? return nil end function Modpack.OnBeforeFire(weapon: Weapon): boolean? return true end function Modpack.OnBeforeAim(weapon: Weapon, isAiming: boolean): boolean? return true end function Modpack.OnBeforeReload(weapon: Weapon): boolean? return true end function Modpack.OnReloadStageStart(weapon: Weapon, stage: StagedReloadStage) print(weapon.Name, "has started the", stage.Name, "reload stage") end function Modpack.OnReloadStageEnd(weapon: Weapon, stage: StagedReloadStage) print(weapon.Name, "has finished the", stage.Name, "reload stage") end function Modpack.OnReloadCancel(weapon: Weapon, stage: StagedReloadStage) print(weapon.Name, "cancelled the", stage.Name, "reload stage") end return Modpack

searchDocs.title: OnEquip​
searchDocs.content: </> Modpack.OnEquip(weapon: IgneousWeapon) → () Called when a weapon is equipped by the player.

searchDocs.title: OnUnequip​
searchDocs.content: </> Modpack.OnUnequip(weapon: IgneousWeapon) → () Called when a weapon is unequipped by the player.

searchDocs.title: OnFireStart​
searchDocs.content: </> Modpack.OnFireStart(weapon: IgneousWeapon) → () Called when the player starts firing (mouse down/trigger pressed).

searchDocs.title: OnFireEnd​
searchDocs.content: </> Modpack.OnFireEnd(weapon: IgneousWeapon) → () Called when the player stops firing (mouse down/trigger released).

searchDocs.title: OnFire​
searchDocs.content: </> Modpack.OnFire(weapon: IgneousWeapon) → () Called once per trigger-pull fire event, before any projectiles are cast. Intended for camera-effect modpacks (recoil impulse, etc.) reacting once per shot event rather than once per projectile.

searchDocs.title: OnProjectileFire​
searchDocs.content: </> Modpack.OnProjectileFire( weapon: IgneousWeapon, origin: { position: Vector3 , direction: Vector3 },-- The origin of the projectile result: RaycastResult?-- Hit result if the raycast struck something, nil otherwise ) → () Called once per projectile cast. Fires multiple times per OnFire for multi-projectile weapons.

searchDocs.title: OnAmmoChange​
searchDocs.content: </> Modpack.OnAmmoChange( weapon: IgneousWeapon, previous: number,-- The previous ammo count current: number,-- The new ammo count reason: "reload" | "fired" | "set"-- Why the ammo changed ) → () Called whenever the weapon's ammo count changes.

searchDocs.title: OnAimStart​
searchDocs.content: </> Modpack.OnAimStart(weapon: IgneousWeapon) → () Called when the weapon enters its aiming state via SetAiming.

searchDocs.title: OnAimEnd​
searchDocs.content: </> Modpack.OnAimEnd(weapon: IgneousWeapon) → () Called when the weapon leaves its aiming state via SetAiming.

searchDocs.title: OnCameraUpdate​
searchDocs.content: </> Modpack.OnCameraUpdate( weapon: IgneousWeapon, dt: number-- Delta time since the last frame ) → vector?-- A rotational offset (x, y in degrees, z unused) to add to this frame's total Called every PreRender frame. Every modpack's returned offset is summed and applied once to the viewmodel/camera. Use this for recoil, sway, breathing shake, ADS lean, etc.

searchDocs.title: OnBeforeFire​
searchDocs.content: </> Modpack.OnBeforeFire(weapon: IgneousWeapon) → boolean?-- Return false to prevent the weapon from firing Called before a fire attempt. Any modpack returning false cancels the fire.

searchDocs.title: OnBeforeAim​
searchDocs.content: </> Modpack.OnBeforeAim( weapon: IgneousWeapon, isAiming: boolean-- The aiming state being requested ) → boolean?-- Return false to prevent the aim state change Called before SetAiming changes the weapon's aiming state. Any modpack returning false cancels the change.

searchDocs.title: OnBeforeReload​
searchDocs.content: </> Modpack.OnBeforeReload(weapon: IgneousWeapon) → boolean?-- Return false to prevent the reload from starting Called before a reload attempt. Any modpack returning false cancels the reload.

searchDocs.title: OnReloadStageStart​
searchDocs.content: </> Modpack.OnReloadStageStart( weapon: IgneousWeapon, stage: StagedReloadStage ) → () Called when a reload stage begins. Simple and Progressive reloads synthesize a single ad-hoc stage so this fires consistently across all three reload types.

searchDocs.title: OnReloadStageEnd​
searchDocs.content: </> Modpack.OnReloadStageEnd( weapon: IgneousWeapon, stage: StagedReloadStage ) → () Called when a reload stage completes without being cancelled.

searchDocs.title: OnReloadCancel​
searchDocs.content: </> Modpack.OnReloadCancel( weapon: IgneousWeapon, stage: StagedReloadStage-- The stage that was interrupted ) → () Called when a reload is cancelled mid-stage.
